Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. What proof do we have from the writings of Ellen White that the day begins at sunset.
2. Was Ellen White ever shown in vision that Saturday was the Sabbath?
3. Does wearing jewelry prevent someone from going to heaven?
